english:
You shall bless. Gospel of Dismissal: Mark 8:10 "And straightway..." to verse 26 "say..." in [the tone of] the day.

The Sixth Sunday. Tone 2 [bk]. Resurrection Hymn: "Pharaoh" (Փարաւոն). Canticle [of the Fathers]: Tone 7 [dz], "You Who Are Praised" (Որ բարեբանեալդ). Morning Gospel: Luke 14:25 "And there went..." to 15:32 "...and was found." Midday Psalm 106 [107], "Give thanks..." "My heart is ready..." "Bless God..." Acts 20:17 "And from Miletus..." to verse 38 "...into the ship." Psalm 64 [65], "Praise is due to You." Catholic [Epistle] 1 John 3:2 "Beloved..." to verse 6 "...has known Him." Alleluia. Psalm 147, "Praise [the Lord, O] Jerusalem." Gospel: John 9:39 "And Jesus said..." to 10:10 "...they might have [it] more abundantly."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 16:13 "When Jesus came..." to 17:13 "...said to them." And they shall go out in procession with Cross and Gospel, singing the hymn, Tone 2 [bk]: "Life-giving Cross" (Խաչն կենարար). Then Psalm 4:6 "There is signed..." Response: "When I call..." Gospel: Matthew 27:45 "And having taken..." to verse 50 "...yielded up His spirit." And they shall bless the four corners of the world [Antastan]. Litany: "By this Holy Cross." Prayer: "Keep us." And then "Bow down" and "Live." Psalm: "Sing..." "Enter..." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi], Tone 2 [bk]: "They anticipated" (Կանխեցին), "Your Resurrection" (Զյարութիւն), and "Universal" (Զտիեզերական). Gospel of Dismissal: Mark 8:27 "And Jesus went out..." to 9:1 "...because of Him."

Monday. Tone 3 [gd]. Resurrection Hymn: "Helper" (Օգնական). Canticle: Tone 7 [dz], "You Who on the Four-Faced." Morning Gospel: Luke 16:1 "And He said..." to verse 31 "...they will be convinced." Midday Psalm 109 [110], "The Lord said..." "Give thanks..." "Blessed is the man..." Acts 21:1 "And it came to pass..." to verse 15 "...the will of the Lord be done." Psalm 64 [65], "Praise is due to You." Catholic [Epistle] 1 John 3:7 "Little children..." to verse 10 "...the children of the devil." Alleluia. Psalm 147, "Praise [the Lord, O] Jerusalem." Gospel: John 10:11 "I am the good shepherd..." to verse 21 "...to open the eyes of the blind."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 17:14 "And when they..." to verse 20 "...and fasting." Psalm: "Come and..." "Our God..." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi], Tone 5 [gd]: "Wondrous" (Հրաշալի) and "Give glory" (Տուք զփառս). Gospel of Dismissal: Mark 9:13 "And having come..." to verse 28 "...and with prayer."

Tuesday. Tone 6 [gk]. Resurrection Hymn: "Sing" (Երգեցէք). Canticle: Tone 7 [dz], "When You were on the Cross." Morning Gospel: Luke 17:1 "And He said..." to verse 19 "...have saved you." Midday Psalm 112 [113], "Praise..." "When He went out..." "I loved..." Acts 21:15 "And after those days..." to verse 29 "...sacrifice by them." Psalm 5:12 "Lord, as with a shield." Catholic [Epistle] 1 John 3:10 "Whosoever..." to verse 20 "...and He knows all things." Alleluia. Psalm 20 [21], "The Lord in Your strength." Gospel: John 10:22 "At that time there was..." to verse 42 "...in Him there."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 17:21 "And while they..." to 18:9 "...into the hell of fire." Psalm: "Our God in heaven..." "When He went out..." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi], Tone 5 [gd]: "A vision of lightning" (Տեսիլ փայլակ) and "Ineffable" (Յանճառ). Gospel of Dismissal: Mark 9:29 "And going out from there..." to verse 49 "...with one another."

Wednesday. Tone 7 [dz]. Resurrection Hymn: "We shall bless" (Օրհնեսցուք). Canticle: Tone 7 [dz], "Only-begotten Son." Morning Gospel: Luke 17:20 "And when He was asked..." to verse 37 "...will be gathered." Midday Psalm 115 [116], "I believed..." "Praise..." "Give thanks..." Acts 21:27 "And when..." to verse 36 "...Away with him!" Psalm 147, "Praise [the Lord, O] Jerusalem." Catholic [Epistle] 1 John 3:21 "Beloved..." to 4:6 "...of error." Alleluia. Psalm 64 [65], "Praise is due to You." Gospel: John 11:1 "And there was a certain sick man..." to verse 46 "...what Jesus had done."

In the Evening
First Gospel: Matthew 18:10 "Take heed..." to verse 35 "...their trespasses." Psalm: "Let Your hand be..." "You Who shepherd..." Evening Hymn [Hambartsi], Tone 7 [dz]: "Awesome" (Ահագին). Gospel of Dismissal: Mark 10:1 "And from there..." to verse 12 "...she commits adultery with another."
